title: Small Scale Expression and Purification of A71 Inactive 2A Protease C110A
author: Xiaomin Ni
materials: Tag cleavage, overnight dislysis and reverse IMAC

steps.title: Transform and Store Bacteria
steps.instruction: Transform Enterovirus Coxsackievirus A71 inactive 2A protease with mutation C110A (addgene Catalog #228633) into BL21(DE3) cells and store a glycerol stock at -80 °C.

steps.title: Prepare Starter Culture
steps.instruction: Inoculate 50 mL of 2X LB supplemented with 50 ug/mL kanamycin in a 250 mL flask tube using a sterile loop to scrape some of the glycerol stock. Grow the starter culture overnight at 37 °C with 220 rpm shaking.

steps.title: Inoculate and Grow Main Culture
steps.instruction: Inoculate 1 L custom autoinduction media supplemented with 50 ug/mL kanamycin in a baffled flask using the 10 mL starter culture. Cap the flask with vented screw caps containing 0.2uM PTFE membranes. Incubate at 200 rpm and 37 °C (typically 6 L of culture is grown for each purification).

steps.title: Cool Culture and Induce Expression
steps.instruction: Once the OD 600 reaches approximately 2.0 (typically around 5 hours), lower the temperature to 18 °C and shaker speed to 180 rpm, and incubate for 1 hour to cool down. Induce expression by adding IPTG to a final concentration of 0.5mM and continue incubation at 180 rpm, 18 °C, overnight.

steps.title: Harvest Cells
steps.instruction: Harvest the cells by centrifugation at 4000 x g, 4 °C, for 30 minutes. Discard the supernatant and store the pellet at -80 °C (expected pellet weight for 6L TB media is around 90g).

steps.title: Lyse Cells
steps.instruction: Thaw and resuspend the pellet using ~10mL of lysis buffer per g of pellet. Lyse cells by sonication on ice (5 seconds on, 10 seconds off) for a total time of 20 minutes at 30% amplitude, ensuring the pellet remains cold.

steps.title: Clarify Lysate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the lysed cells at 20000 x g, 4 °C, for 1 hour to remove insoluble cell debris and collect the soluble fraction in a bottle at 4 °C.

steps.title: Prepare IMAC Column
steps.instruction: Dispense 5 mL of IMAC resin (Ni Sepharose 6 FF, Cytiva) into a gravity flow column. Rinse the resin with ~10 CV distilled water to remove storage solution, then with ~10 CV binding buffer to equilibrate.

steps.title: Bind Target Protein
steps.instruction: Resuspend the equilibrated resin with 10 mL of binding buffer and add to the supernatant bottle. Incubate the resin with the soluble fraction for 30 minutes while rotating or mixing gently at 4 °C. Load the resin/soluble fraction mix back onto the gravity flow column and retain the flow through separately for SDS-PAGE analysis.

steps.title: Wash and Elute Protein
steps.instruction: Wash the column with 10 CV of base buffer, followed by 10 CV of wash buffer 1 and 10 CV of wash buffer 2, allowing each to pass through completely. Collect washes separately for SDS-PAGE. Elute the protein with 1.5 CV of elution buffer; repeat this elution step once more to collect a total of 2 separate elution fractions. Measure total protein concentration using Nanodrop.

steps.title: Clean and Store IMAC Resin
steps.instruction: Wash used IMAC resin with 10 CV of base buffer and leave the column submerged in a small amount of base buffer to keep the resin moist for future reverse IMAC (rIMAC) use.

steps.title: Analyze Initial Purification
steps.instruction: Run SDS-PAGE of all samples from total lysis supernatant to final elution. Stain the gel with Coomassie Blue to identify fractions containing the target molecular weight.

steps.title: Cleave Affinity Tag
steps.instruction: Add His-SENP1 SUMO protease to the protein sample at a 1:100 ratio (determined by Nanodrop). Incubate at 4 °C via dialysis overnight to cleave the affinity tag and dilute imidazole concentration.

steps.title: Perform Reverse IMAC (rIMAC)
steps.instruction: Pour the cleaved protein and SUMO tag over the washed IMAC resin and collect the flow through (rIMAC). Wash the resin with 10-12 mL wash buffer 1 and 2 to remove remaining target protein. Wash the resin with 15 mL elution buffer to check for non-specific binding. Collect FT and washes for SDS-PAGE analysis.

steps.title: Concentrate and Clarify Protein
steps.instruction: Concentrate the rIMAC fractions containing the target protein to a final volume of under 5 mL using 10,000 MWCO spin concentrators. Remove solid aggregates by centrifugation at 17200 x g, 4 °C, for 10 minutes, then immediately draw up the supernatant with a 5mL syringe and blunt-tip fill needle.

steps.title: Perform Size Exclusion Chromatography
steps.instruction: Using an AKTA Pure system, inject the sample onto a 5mL sample loop and run it through a HiLoad 16/60 Superdex 75 pg gel filtration column at 1 mL/min using gel filtration buffer as the mobile phase. Collect 1mL fractions.

steps.title: Final Polishing and Storage
steps.instruction: Analyze SEC fractions by SDS-PAGE and pool those with the highest amounts of pure 2A protease. Concentrate the pooled fractions to 15 mg/mL using a 10 kDa MWCO centrifugal concentrator. Take 1 µL for SDS-PAGE and 1 µL for mass spectroscopy (MS). Aliquot the protein, flash-freeze in liquid nitrogen, and store at -80 °C.
